item.title: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3
item.description: An NPR analysis finds 70 House districts where Democrats and Republicans are each investing more than six figures in advertising during the final few days of the election, including in deep red areas.

item.title: Hackers expose the identities of more than 40,000 DHS employees
item.description: A group of hacktivists calling themselves Distributed Denial of Secrets, said the unmasking of ICE agents, DHS operatives and contractors was fair play, given the government's lack of transparency.

item.title: Forecasters are predicting a warmer and wetter winter. Here's how El Niño will affect your region

item.title: New book revisits the 2023 killing of an unhoused man in crisis on the NYC subway
item.description: Jordan Neely was frightening fellow passengers. A former Marine named Daniel Penny put Neely into a chokehold, killing him. Journalist Anand Giridharadas investigates the incident in Man in the Mirror.

item.title: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
item.description: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
item.description: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

item.title: Partnerships between ICE and local police surge, report finds
item.description: The number of state and local officers working with Immigration and Customs Enforcement has doubled in size in the last eight months, according to a new report from the immigration reform advocacy group FWD.us.
